context: When building a real-time PyQt5 HUD using lightweight-charts-python to display predictions, passing data to the subchart causes empty renders and JS errors.
learning: The subchart must have its own 'Master' candle dataframe initialized and updated synchronously alongside the top chart so that the X-axis time scale advances. Additionally, the pandas Series provided to line.update() MUST have an explicit .name matching the line's name (e.g. s.name = 'P_Long'), otherwise the Python wrapper serializes the column as 'value', triggering 'Cannot read property series of undefined' in JavaScript.
action: Ensure the subchart receives a dummy OHLC update with every tick, and assign strict string names to pandas Series before calling line.update().
